settings.text: Our subscription program allows you to easily replenish your self-care essentials when it's time to restock.

settings.repere: Texte · Create an account or log in to your ac…
settings.text: Create an account or log in to your account to manage your frequency, delivery, quantity, or product swaps. You can also cancel your subscription in your account at any time.

settings.repere: Texte · You will receive a 15% discount on all…
settings.text: You will receive a 15% discount on all subscription products and free standard shipping within the United States. You will also earn 2x loyalty points with every subscription order that ships.
